data.value: Play stereo music through every speaker of a 5.1 or 7.1 system.

data.name: Upmix.DuplicateHint
data.value: Same music on every pair, centre and bass filled in

data.name: Upmix.SurroundHint
data.value: Ambience to the rears, wide stage in front

data.name: Upmix.Note

data.name: Server.AccountsMoved
data.value: Accounts and device sync are managed in Account & Sync.

data.name: AccountSync.CreateHelp
data.value: Your phone and other devices sign in with this to browse, play and sync this library. The password is stored hashed and never leaves this computer.

data.name: AccountSync.PairHelp
data.value: On your phone, open the Noctis app (or any Subsonic app), scan the code or type the address, and sign in with your account.

data.name: AccountSync.ServerOffHelp

data.comment: Pairing block when the server is off

data.name: AccountSync.OtherHelp
data.value: Extra accounts that can sign in to this library from their own devices.

data.name: Sync.Description
data.value: Favourites, ratings, play counts and playlists stay the same on every device signed in to your account. Changes meet here; the newest one wins.

data.name: Sync.WhatSyncs
data.value: Music files stay where they are — only what you do with them syncs. Requires Noctis Server (Integrations).

data.name: LyricsStudioSettings.Description
data.value: Listens to a song and times its lyrics word by word — or writes them down when there are none. Everything runs on this computer; you review each song before anything is saved.

data.name: LyricsStudioSettings.WordTimingsHint
data.value: Save enhanced LRC with a time for every word (karaoke sweep). Off saves one time per line.

data.name: LyricsStudioSettings.EmbedTags
data.value: Also write lyrics into the file's tags

data.name: LyricsStudioSettings.EmbedTagsHint
data.value: The .lrc file next to the song is always written; this additionally stores the plain lyrics inside the audio file.

data.name: LyricsStudioSettings.OpenHelp
data.value: Opens Lyrics Studio with up to 40 songs that lack the format above: with word-by-word timings on, songs with only line-timed LRC are included; songs that already have ELRC are not. You can also right-click any songs → Lyrics → Open in Lyrics Studio.

data.name: LyricsStudio.Subtitle
data.value: Times your lyrics against the recording, or transcribes when there are none. Review each song, fix any word, then save.

data.name: LyricsStudio.SkipAlreadyTimed
data.value: Skip songs that already have this format

data.name: LyricsStudio.SkipAlreadyTimedTip
data.value: ELRC (a time for every word) and LRC (one time per line) are different formats. With word timings on, songs that only have line-timed LRC are still processed; songs that already have ELRC are left alone.

data.name: LyricsStudio.NeedsFfmpeg
data.value: ffmpeg is needed to decode songs. Set its path under Settings → Audio → Audio tools, then reopen Lyrics Studio.

data.name: LyricsStudio.ReviewEmptyBody
data.value: Pick a song. Songs that already have synced lyrics open here right away; press Start for the rest. Check the words, nudge the timing and save.

data.name: LyricsStudio.Upgrade
data.comment: Review button, shown for line-level lyrics

data.name: LyricsStudio.UpgradeTip
data.value: Runs the speech model over this song and times every word of the loaded lines (ELRC). The line-level LRC is kept alongside.

data.name: LyricsStudio.ReviewHint
data.value: Click a time to hear that line. Edit any text in place. Tinted lines were not heard clearly — check them first.

data.name: LyricsStudio.RedoTip
data.value: Ignore the found lyrics and write down what is actually sung

data.name: LyricsStudio.Words
data.comment: Per-line toggle that opens the word strip

data.name: LyricsStudio.WordsTip
data.value: Show each word with its time. Click a word to hear it; nudge or tap to retime it.

data.name: LyricsStudio.WordEarlier
data.value: Selected word 50 ms earlier (its neighbours stay put)

data.name: LyricsStudio.WordLater
data.value: Selected word 50 ms later (its neighbours stay put)

data.name: LyricsStudio.TapTip
data.value: Plays the line; press Space (or Tap) as each word is sung. One more tap after the last word marks the line end.
